entries.title: Messages and replies
entries.description: Mermaid sequence syntax with solid, dashed and open-headed messages.
entries.scope: Implemented Mermaid sequence subset; script-free SVG.

entries.title: Annotated interactions and symbols
entries.description: Native ZenUML interactions with typed participant symbols and styled messages.
entries.scope: Implemented Mermaid ZenUML syntax and illustrative playback, without executing calls.

entries.title: Services, ports and connections
entries.description: Native architecture-beta with groups, services and authored port connections.
entries.scope: Architecture rendering and bounded structural exploration, without deployment execution.

entries.title: Process with supplied diagram geometry
entries.description: A BPMN XML process rendered with its supplied diagram interchange geometry.
entries.scope: Process rendering and structural illustration. No token simulation or process execution.

entries.title: Collaboration and message flows
entries.description: Pools, participants and message flows with an optional offline player.
entries.scope: Collaboration rendering and drawn-structure illustration. Conditions and tokens are not executed.

entries.title: Review across responsibility bands
entries.description: Native Mermaid swimlane-beta with directed interactions and a return path.
entries.scope: Implemented native swimlane syntax and bounded structural exploration.

entries.title: Mermaid request review
entries.description: Mermaid flowchart with nested groups, labelled branches and a return path.
entries.scope: Mermaid 12.2.0 flowchart/graph syntax with structural playback and bounded exploration; conditions are not evaluated.

entries.title: PlantUML modern order activity
entries.description: Modern PlantUML activity syntax with an explicit partition, lanes, repeat loop and parallel branches.
entries.scope: PlantUML 1.2026.9 modern activity syntax with structural scenarios; actions and fork synchronization are not executed.

entries.title: PlantUML legacy request activity
entries.description: Legacy PlantUML activity syntax with an activity alias, partition and labelled branches.
entries.scope: PlantUML 1.2026.9 legacy activity syntax with structural playback and bounded exploration; no workflow execution.

entries.title: Date pattern railroad
entries.description: PlantUML regex block with named groups, character sets, repetition and a negative lookahead.
entries.scope: Static regex syntax diagram and structural exploration; no embedded regex execution engine.

entries.title: Externally supplied match evidence
entries.description: The date pattern with a successful trace supplied by the frozen test trace provider.
entries.scope: External provider evidence only. The renderer does not execute the regex or infer failure for unvisited paths.

entries.title: Arithmetic grammar railroad
entries.description: PlantUML EBNF with recursive rule references and a note.
entries.scope: Static grammar diagram and structural exploration; parse evidence requires an external provider.

entries.title: Externally supplied parse failure
entries.description: An arithmetic grammar with failure evidence supplied by the frozen test trace provider.
entries.scope: External provider evidence only. No parser is executed inside the renderer.

entries.title: Nested order data
entries.description: PlantUML JSON with nested collections, exact numbers and highlighted data.
entries.scope: Implemented native JSON data-tree rendering and structural exploration.

entries.title: Service configuration tree
entries.description: PlantUML YAML with flow and block values and lists of maps.
entries.scope: Implemented native YAML string scalars and data-tree rendering; no YAML execution.
